SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0.0) AS totalGmv, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= #{startOfToday} THEN amount ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS todayGmv, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= #{startOfYesterday} AND create_time < #{startOfToday} THEN amount ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS yesterdayGmv FROM payment_order
WHERE status IN (1, 2)
SELECT DATE(create_time) AS dateStr, IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0.0) AS dayGmv, COUNT(*) AS dayCount FROM payment_order WHERE status IN (1, 2) AND create_time >= #{startTimestamp} GROUP BY DATE(create_time)
